build/editorial/L01.json.dek.en: Within walking distance of the sea, about five minutes from De Shalit Square, a private estate of about 700 sqm on a 1.1-dunam plot: three levels, seven suites, a large pool and a living room that opens to the garden. The price and the address are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L01.json.story.en[0]: The estate runs to about 700 sqm built over three levels, on a plot of about 1,100 sqm in a quiet part of Herzliya Pituach, within walking distance of the sea and about five minutes from De Shalit Square.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L01.json.story.en[1]: The bedrooms are planned as spacious suites, seven in all, including a very large master suite. The large living room opens to a pastoral garden and a large pool, and beside them are a cinema room, a gym, a wine cellar, a lift and a large safe room.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L01.json.story.en[2]: A smart electrical system and underfloor heating run through the whole house, and custom carpentry was built for every bedroom and along the levels. Viewings are by appointment only.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L01.json.building_lead.en: The street, the plot and the rights are given on direct request. The checks below apply to any house in Herzliya Pituach.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L01.json.numbers.lead.en: The price is given on direct request. To support planning, purchase tax and financing are shown at three illustrative price points derived from published market data. They are not a valuation and not the asking price.
build/editorial/L01.json.numbers.ledger[0].note.en: 700 sqm at zone Bet to Vav rates for houses over 125 sqm; NIS 99,617 in zone Alef. Zone and charged area to be confirmed
build/editorial/L01.json.market.h2.en: Villas in Herzliya Pituach: deals and listings
build/editorial/L01.json.faq[0].a.en: The price is given on direct request. For orientation, the median asking price across 15 Herzliya Pituach villas of 500 to 900 sqm on 1,000 to 1,200 sqm plots is NIS 59.2 million, or NIS 77,023 per built sqm.[[S37,S60]]
build/editorial/L01.json.faq[3].a.en: Within walking distance, and about five minutes from De Shalit Square. Zevulun Beach is about 750 m from the square in a straight line; the distance from the plot itself comes with the address.[[S1,S2]]
build/editorial/L01.json.schools_override[0].note.en: Municipal elementary school. For 2026-27 its graduates are zoned to Yad Giora middle school. Registration zone for the address to be confirmed with the municipality.
build/editorial/L01.json.schools_override[9].note.en: 65 HaShomron St, Even Yehuda. An independent American-curriculum school taught in English, founded in 1958 under the auspices of the US Embassy, on a 73-dunam campus. About 11.7 km in a straight line from De Shalit Square; tuition and school buses to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L01.json.transport_override[1].status.en: Under construction: 39 km and 62 stations from Rishon LeZion and Holon to Herzliya. Partial opening expected at the end of 2028 and the full line in 2030; Herzliya station locations to be confirmed.

build/editorial/L02.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Sarona, central Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L02.json.dek.en: A high floor at B.S.R Sarona, with a west-facing balcony that looks to the sea: 4.5 rooms on 128 sqm, planned and finished by a leading designer, in a building that received its occupancy certificate in March 2026. The rent is given on request.
build/editorial/L02.json.story.en[0]: The apartment sits on a high floor in a new tower at B.S.R Sarona, with a 14 sqm balcony facing west and an open view to the sea. It was planned as five rooms and converted to 4.5, on 128 sqm built.[[S1,S5]]
build/editorial/L02.json.story.en[1]: A leading designer planned the apartment and chose the materials: an island kitchen, concealed integrated refrigerators, a premium cooktop, quality parquet and designed lighting throughout.[[S2,S5]]
build/editorial/L02.json.story.en[2]: It comes with a covered private parking space and a storage room, and the building has 24-hour security and a residents’ gym.[[S4,S5]] B.S.R Sarona is a complex of three towers of about 40 floors and 420 apartments on Arania Osvaldo Street, which received its occupancy certificate on 29 March 2026.[[S7,S8,S9]]
build/editorial/L02.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent is given on direct request. The band is computed from 11 listings of 5-room sea or west-facing units in the project and is not a quote.
build/editorial/L02.json.numbers.extra_kpis[3].small.en: Another agency; it may be a different unit
build/editorial/L02.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[1].note.en: NIS 15.4 per sqm as stated in another listing in the project, on 128 to 142 sqm; to be confirmed
build/editorial/L02.json.faq[0].a.en: The rent is given on direct request. Eleven listings of 5-room sea or west-facing units in the project ask NIS 130 to 148 per built sqm, about NIS 16,640 to 18,944 a month for 128 sqm. This is a computation, not a quote.[[S84]]
build/editorial/L02.json.faq[1].a.en: The apartment was planned as five rooms and converted to 4.5.[[S1]] Check the change and the integrity of the safe room on the unit plan.

build/editorial/L03.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Sarona, central Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L03.json.dek.en: A high floor in a new tower in Sarona, with a south-west balcony and an open view to the sea and the city: five rooms on 117 sqm, parking and storage, immediate entry. NIS 15,500 a month.
build/editorial/L03.json.story.en[0]: Five rooms on 117 sqm built and a 14 sqm sun balcony facing south-west, on a high floor with an open view to the sea and across Tel Aviv.[[S2,S1]] The apartment is new, includes kitchen appliances, attached parking and storage, and is available for immediate entry.[[S7,S8]] The rent is NIS 15,500 a month.[[S13]]
build/editorial/L03.json.story.en[1]: B.S.R Sarona is a complex of three towers of about 40 floors and 420 apartments on Arania Osvaldo Street, in the southern part of the Sarona district.[[S10,S11]] B.S.R Group is the developer and project manager, Electra is the main contractor, and the project received its occupancy certificate on 29 March 2026.[[S12]]
build/editorial/L03.json.building_lead.en: The management fee and the name of the management company are given on request. Another listing in the project stated NIS 15.4 per sqm.[[S30]]
build/editorial/L03.json.future_override[2].impact.en: Sales recorded in 2026 carry a 2027 building year; if work continues, expect construction just south of the project.
build/editorial/L03.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent, computed against 2026 rates and the Fair Rental Law rules.
build/editorial/L03.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[1].note.en: NIS 15.4 per sqm as stated in another listing in the project, on 117 to 131 sqm; to be confirmed
build/editorial/L03.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[2].note.en: 131 sqm including the balcony at newest-code rates, zone 2 to zone 1; zone to be confirmed
build/editorial/L03.json.schools_override[0].note.en: About 80 pupils per grade; about 313 m from Arania Osvaldo Street. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L03.json.schools_override[1].note.en: About 72 pupils per grade; about 266 m from the street. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L03.json.schools_override[2].note.en: About 280 m from the street. Admission terms to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L03.json.schools_override[3].note.en: Admission terms and distance to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L03.json.faq[0].a.en: NIS 15,500, and with the management fee and arnona an estimated NIS 18,292 to 18,751 a month.[[S13,S30,G_KH_TLV]]
build/editorial/L03.json.faq[1].a.en: A high floor with an open view to the sea and across Tel Aviv; a January 2026 post gave floor 20. The balcony faces south-west.[[S1,S2]]

build/editorial/L04.json.kicker.en: For sale · Exclusive · Tzukei Aviv, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L04.json.dek.en: At the western edge of Tzukei Aviv, in a nine-floor boutique building: three rooms on about 90 sqm with a 12 sqm sun balcony facing a green view, a safe room inside the apartment, two parking spaces and a storage room. NIS 4,650,000.
build/editorial/L04.json.story.en[1]: The built area is about 90 sqm, with a 12 sqm sun balcony facing an open green view. The layout includes a master suite and a bright living space, and the apartment is particularly quiet.[[S1,S2,S3]]
build/editorial/L04.json.story.en[2]: The building has a designed lobby and a residents’ gym, and the management fee is NIS 600 a month.[[S87,S1]] The apartment is ready to move in, and Tel Baruch beach and the coastal park promenade are about five minutes on foot.
build/editorial/L04.json.spec[0].rows[2].dd.en: 12 sqm sun balcony facing an open green view
build/editorial/L04.json.building_lead.en: The developer, the contractor and the date of the occupancy certificate are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L04.json.location.en[0]: Tzukei Aviv runs from Unitzman Street in the north to Propes Street in the south, between Namir Road and the sea.[[S20]] Gimel HaHadasha is the name for its newer part, built beside the Azorei Chen towers.[[S19,S16]] Data published by Mako put the median deal in Azorei Chen from early 2023 to October 2025 at NIS 5.9 million, the fifth highest neighborhood median in Israel.[[S73]]
build/editorial/L04.json.numbers.lead.en: The price, computed against the tax and lending rules published up to 16 September 2026.
build/editorial/L04.json.numbers.ledger[1].note.en: 102 sqm including the balcony at the 2026 rates for the newest building code, zones 2 and 1. The zone is to be confirmed; NIS 1,680 is shown without a period.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L04.json.market.where_override.rent:0.en: Same building: furnished 3.5 rooms with an existing tenancy
build/editorial/L04.json.faq[1].a.en: The balcony faces an open green view, and the building is presented as the first building to the sea. The land between the neighborhood and the sea is covered by plan TA/3700, which a planner quoted by Globes described as buildings of eight floors at most.[[S23]] Check what is planned west of the building before paying for a view.
build/editorial/L04.json.faq[3].a.en: The management fee is NIS 600 a month. At 2026 rates for a new building, arnona would be about NIS 771 to 960 a month, depending on the arnona zone.[[G_KH_TLV]]
build/editorial/L04.json.schools_override[0].note.en: 13 Yair Rosenblum St. The registration zone for the address is to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L04.json.schools_override[1].note.en: 4A David Shimoni St. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L04.json.schools_override[2].note.en: About 91 pupils per grade. Registration zone to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L04.json.transport_override[0].status.en: Under construction. The southern section is expected in 2028 and the full line in 2030; the route is planned along the new road inside plan 3700. The nearest station location is to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L04.json.future_override[4].impact.en: One record shows active construction of 13 floors and 41 units with completion in early 2028, while project-tlv lists it as completed. If work is active, expect building on the same street until 2028.
